verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API-first banking platform with a public OpenAPI spec, an llms.txt index, and documented APIs for customers, accounts, cards and payments, plus webhooks for event pushes, so agents can reach core banking data programmatically without a dashboard. The evidence does not show a dedicated read surface for transaction history or pending/authorized activity on Synctera accounts; the Plaid/Finicity transaction retrieval covers external accounts only. Document coverage is limited to customer verification and disclosures, and there is no MCP server. Missing for 10: documented transaction-history and pending-activity read endpoints for Synctera accounts, a statements/documents retrieval API, an official MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
